behavior: Mechanism/input/output queries reserve at most two existing source slots for concrete operation text and necessary preceding context. Source texts/IDs/locations are never concatenated or rewritten.

Candidates require the same owned paper and pinned index version, unique source/chunk identities, literal body component/query matches and operational language. Repeated paper headers do not count as component matches.
The best semantic hit and existing context pairs stay protected. Ambiguous/missing prerequisites skip the candidate; the result stays within the existing limit.
The existing bounded 400-document index cache is reused, live scope checked again for each call. No extra model, PDF fetch or query-rewrite request is introduced.
Server-owned immutable sourcePrecision contract 1 enables the new selector only for new runs; historical unmarked retrieval is unchanged.

Native JSON contract 4 adds neutral planning instructions and distinguishes unverified plan examples from source evidence in synthesis/compaction/repair. Earlier native versions retain their exact messages.
Every trusted system/framing remains within the existing 1024-token reservation. Candidate retrieval and trusted instructions do not establish factual or answer-completeness acceptance.
boundary: A live retired-case diagnostic remains separate from independent acceptance. All original first failures and historical unknowns are retained.
